identity.notes: Preserves the opened reference: elongated ivory deer skull with hollow sockets and long muzzle, large paired many-tined stag antlers, intertwined brown bark, desaturated moss and one secondary raven on image-right shoulder. Full antler crown and every visible tine are intact; no glowing eyes or human face. Fine branch shapes are a painted interpretation rather than a topology match.

palette_and_craft.notes: Weathered ivory bone, warm brown antlers/bark, muted moss green and charcoal-black raven/backdrop. Matte brushwork, readable dry bark and bone; no saturated magical glow.

crop.square: Full head/hair/antler silhouette visible with charcoal margin. Shoulders included; lower chest fades into background.
crop.method_and_limits: Visual inspection of the actual final PNG and approximate manually located identity landmarks, followed by circle-distance arithmetic. This is not automated silhouette segmentation or a runtime UI test. The lower bust is softly faded and is not included in the head/antler landmark guarantee.
